https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: Roost.ai provides a platform for efficient and automated creation, management, and deployment of ephemeral environments for software testing and development.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create on-demand ephemeral environments based on predefined configurations.
Users must have the ability to integrate the platform with existing CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment processes.
Users must be able to monitor the status and performance of active environments via a dashboard.
Users must have access to role-based permissions to control who can create, manage, or delete environments.
Users must be able to schedule automatic cleanup or expiration of ephemeral environments to optimize resource usage.
Users must be able to clone production environments for testing purposes while maintaining data isolation.
Users must receive notifications or alerts for environment failures or resource limit breaches.
